nina: Quick note: our postmortem actions are often one-off tickets with no severity context, so recurring patterns slip through. I prototyped a "triage matrix + pattern fingerprint" approach to standardize followups. Sharing the core idea below. PTAL.

carlos: interesting. what's the triage matrix look like?

nina: pasted short version. kept it compact so it's easy to adopt: 

```
Triagematrix (assign at T+24h):
- Severity A (customer-impacting, partial outage): owner + exec sponsor, rollback decision owner, target remediation ETA 7d, weekly stakeholder updates
- Severity B (degraded performance, partial feature failure): owner + backup, target remediation ETA 14d, biweekly check-ins
- Severity C (minor/no-customer impact): owner, target remediation ETA 45d, async updates

Action scaffold created at T+24h (incident-bot command):
`/incident followup scaffold --owner @owner --backup @backup --severity A|B|C --due 7d --tags <fingerprint_tags>`

Pattern fingerprint: small structured tags to capture failure signature for recurrence detection: `component:<name>`, `symptom:<http-5xx|latency|job-failure>`, `root-cause:<cache|db|deploy|config|thirdparty>`
If same fingerprint appears 2x within 90d -> auto-escalate to SRE lead + schedule a 60m "pattern-hunt" with product.
```

emma: love the fingerprint tags. will make recurring-detection much simpler. Can we auto-suggest the root-cause tag from logs/alerts?

nina: yep, possible to suggest via alert rule heuristics. keep manual override for accuracy.

raghu: suggest adding an "ownership SLA" column to the matrix: assign within 24h, progress update within 7d for sev A/B, closure review within 45d for C. If SLA missed, incident-bot paginates exec sponsor.

olivia: for IC rotation: propose 5-day IC shifts, named backup on rotation, and an explicit handoff checklist that includes creating the followup scaffold before the IC ends. avoids orphaned items.

carlos: dashboard needs: open actions by severity, median time-to-assign, recurrence count by fingerprint, overdue rate. please also include CSV export for PM/customer updates.

incident-bot: prototype commands available: `/incident followup scaffold` and `/incident followup escalate --fingerprint "component:api symptom:http-5xx"`. Bot will DM owners at T+24h, T+7d, and 14d for overdue items.

emma: who will run the pilot? happy to help instrument detection and suggest tag inference rules.

nina: I'll run a 6-week pilot with the next oncall cohort. goals: assign within 24h for 95% actions, reduce repeat-fingerprint occurrences by 30%, and get dashboard tile live.

raghu: I'll update the runbook language and add the matrix table and handoff checklist.

olivia: I'll coordinate the IC rotation update and the handoff checklist.

carlos: I'll prototype the dashboard tile and CSV export.

incident-bot: Pilot kickoff scheduled: Tue 2025-01-14 09:00 PST. It will create followup scaffolds and post weekly pilot summaries to #eng-oncall.

nina: thanks folks 10. I'll drop the short checklist and sample scaffold command in the channel and send the calendar invite.
